description: Read an owned video’s version, scenes, captions and editable canvas element IDs/capabilities. Optional output_id selects a clip/format; element_offset pages through the canvas inventory. Use the returned version/output, IDs and capabilities with the named direct-edit tools, such as set_element_content or set_element_layout, without a second Clypmint model round. Canvas image IDs name assets already in this version. Returns project data without a visual card.

element_offset.description: Where to go on in the canvas element list, when the answer says there are more.

output_id.description: One output (a hook, a Short or a shape) from check_video; the main video when left out.

video_id.description: The video to read, from list_videos.

name: get_project_context

outputSchema.description: Clypmint get_project_context result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Inspect a video project
